name: PLATO LPfeas Benchmark
description: Evaluates LP solvers on their ability to find primal-dual feasible points for large-scale linear programming instances. The benchmark contains 65 primary and 12 addendum instances drawn from MIPLIB2010, Netlib, and SZTAKI collections, with problem dimensions ranging from 5,000 to over 30 million nonzeros. Both CPU and GPU solver implementations are included, enabling comparison of classical interior-point methods against GPU-accelerated first-order methods.
typical_sota_score: COPT 8.0 and MOSEK 11.0 lead CPU rankings; GPU solvers (cuOpt, cuPDLPx) competitive within 1,000-second GPU time limits.
reputation: Authoritative LP feasibility benchmark maintained by Hans Mittelmann; widely consulted by solver developers.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Time limits: 15,000s CPU, 1,000s GPU. Tolerance: 1e-6 (1e-8 for COPTG). GPU hardware: NVIDIA B200 (192GB).
